_notes.class_descriptor: From DFER-CLIP models/Text.py (class_descriptor_7). The text the DFEW checkpoints were trained with (ChatGPT-generated). This is the baseline.
_notes.facs: Written from the EMFACS prototype action units (Ekman & Friesen): happiness AU6+12, sadness AU1+4+15(+17), neutral none, anger AU4+5+7+23, surprise AU1+2+5+26, disgust AU9+10+15, fear AU1+2+4+5+7+20+26. Check against a FACS reference before the report.
_notes.other_llm: Generated by Claude (Anthropic), Oct 2026, asked the same question as the paper: 'What are useful visual features for the facial expression of {class}?', in the same short 'a, b, c, and d.' style as class_descriptor.
_notes.shuffled: class_descriptor rotated by one class (happiness gets sadness's text, ...). Sanity check: if accuracy barely drops, the model is not using the text.
